chunks: From him, from al-Ḥasan, from Zurʿah, from Samāʿah, who said:
I asked him about qunut—during which salat it is. He said: In every prayer in which you recite aloud, there is qunut; and the qunut is before the ruku' and after the recitation.

key_terms.الرُّكُوعِ: the bowing position in salat, before which qunut is performed
key_terms.الْقُنُوتِ: the supplicatory act performed in salat at a specified point
key_terms.صَلَاةٍ: the ritual prayer in which the ruling is being discussed

ai.seo_question: In which prayers is qunut performed, and when does it occur before or after recitation?
ai.summary: This hadith states the sunnah ruling regarding qunut in prayers with audible recitation. It clarifies that qunut is performed after the recitation and before the ruku', indicating its place within the structure of salat.
